title: PMOS Companion — Final Product Definition
summary: Product definition for a PMOS (formerly PCOS) companion app: positioning, differentiator stack, MVP/v1 feature set, anti-features, coaching scope, open decisions.
scope: n-of-1 pattern engine and Experiment Mode
notes: RETRACTED CONTENT — DO NOT PROPAGATE. This document contains a FALSE traction claim of '500,000+ users across 120 countries' for mycyclesafe.ai. Verified reality: ~63 unique visitors/day, 52 countries, 2.8% India traffic, 2 registered users. The claim survives in the document in three places and every one is retracted: (1) Section 1 Positioning Statement, the phrase "mycyclesafe.ai's 500K-user privacy-first brand"; (2) Section 2 differentiator #2 "The mycyclesafe.ai funnel", which the document itself marks SUPERSEDED; (3) Section 5 'The mycyclesafe.ai Funnel Play', where the 500K/120-country figure appears only inside an explicit correction note kept as the record of an error. The correction note text in Section 5 is the authoritative statement and is the only part of this material that may be carried forward, and only as a correction, never as traction. Synthesizer MUST NOT emit the 500K/120-country figure as a requirement, goal, success metric, or context anywhere. DEPENDENT CLAIMS ALSO FLAGGED (each rests on the inflated figure and must be treated as unverified, not as fact): 'zero CAC' distribution via the in-app bridge; 'brand trust transfers / from the makers of mycyclesafe' as a moat; 'no competitor can buy or rebuild this' and 'no competitor can shortcut this' regarding the funnel asset; the cold-start-kill assumption that imported histories arrive at meaningful volume (with 2 registered users there is effectively no history to import); the segmentation step that presumes a user base large enough to algorithmically segment irregular-cycle cohorts; and any framing of the funnel as a defensible differentiator. Downstream planning should treat mycyclesafe.ai as an unmarketed asset with negligible current usage.
